SELECT * FROM ( SELECT S.StockDate, S.OrderName, S.ShipQty, IFNULL(C.ShipCheckQty,0) AS ShipCheckQty FROM shopwizard.tStkDailyStockState S LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT SP.ProdName, SUM(SP.ProdQty) AS ShipCheckQty FROM shopwizard.tShpShipDirectPrint SP
WHERE SP.ShipCheckDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{pOrderStartDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND SP.ShipCheckDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pOrderEndDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND SP.ShopCode = #{pShopCode} GROUP BY SP.ProdName ) C ON ( S.OrderName = C.ProdName )
WHERE S.StockDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{pStockStartDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND S.StockDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pStockEndDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND S.ShopCode = #{pShopCode} AND S.ShipQty = IFNULL(C.ShipCheckQty,0) AND S.ShipQty <> IFNULL(C.ShipCheckQty,0)
UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ShipCheckDate, '%Y-%m-%d') AS StockDate, ProdName AS OrderName, 0 AS ShipQty, SUM(ProdQty) AS ShipCheckQty FROM shopwizard.tShpShipDirectPrint
WHERE ShipCheckDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{pOrderStartDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND ShipCheckDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pOrderEndDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND ShopCode = #{pShopCode} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT OrderName, ShipQty FROM shopwizard.tStkDailyStockState WHERE shopwizard.tStkDailyStockState.OrderName = shopwizard.tShpShipDirectPrint.ProdName
AND shopwizard.tStkDailyStockState.StockDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{pStockStartDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND shopwizard.tStkDailyStockState.StockDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pStockEndDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ShipCheckDate, '%Y-%m-%d'), ProdName
) ShipCheck LIMIT #{pPageOffset}, #{pPageSize}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT S.StockDate, S.OrderName, S.ShipQty, IFNULL(C.ShipCheckQty,0) AS ShipCheckQty FROM shopwizard.tStkDailyStockState S LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT SP.ProdName, SUM(SP.ProdQty) AS ShipCheckQty FROM shopwizard.tShpShipDirectPrint SP
WHERE SP.ShipCheckDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{pOrderStartDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND SP.ShipCheckDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pOrderEndDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND SP.ShopCode = #{pShopCode} GROUP BY SP.ProdName ) C ON ( S.OrderName = C.ProdName ) WHERE S.StockDate = #{pStockDate} AND S.ShopCode = #{pShopCode} AND S.ShipQty = IFNULL(C.ShipCheckQty,0) AND S.ShipQty <> IFNULL(C.ShipCheckQty,0)
UNION ALL SELECT #{pStockDate} AS StockDate, ProdName AS OrderName, 0 AS ShipQty, SUM(ProdQty) AS ShipCheckQty FROM shopwizard.tShpShipDirectPrint
WHERE ShipCheckDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{pOrderStartDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND ShipCheckDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pOrderEndDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND ShopCode = #{pShopCode} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT OrderName, ShipQty FROM shopwizard.tStkDailyStockState WHERE shopwizard.tStkDailyStockState.OrderName = shopwizard.tShpShipDirectPrint.ProdName AND shopwizard.tStkDailyStockState.StockDate = #{pStockDate} ) GROUP BY ProdName
) ShipCheck

SELECT StockDate, OrderName, SUM(ShipQty) AS ShipQty, SUM(ShipCheckQty) AS ShipCheckQty, SUM(ReEnterCheckQty) AS ReEnterCheckQty FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ShipCheckDate, '%Y-%m-%d') AS StockDate, ProdName AS OrderName, 0 AS ShipQty, SUM(ProdQty) AS ShipCheckQty, 0 AS ReEnterCheckQty FROM shopwizard.tShpShipDirectPrint
WHERE ShipCheckDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{pOrderStartDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND ShipCheckDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pOrderEndDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND ShopCode = #{pShopCode} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ShipCheckDate, '%Y-%m-%d'), ProdName UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(O.RefundCmpletDate, '%Y-%m-%d') AS StockDate, P.ProdName AS OrderName, 0 AS ShipQty, 0 AS ShipCheckQty, SUM(ProdQty) AS ReEnterCheckQty FROM shopwizard.tShpShipDirectPrint P INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrder O ON O.OrderNo = P.Orderno
WHERE O.RefundCmpletDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{pOrderStartDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND O.RefundCmpletDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pOrderEndDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND ShopCode = #{pShopCode} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(O.RefundCmpletDate, '%Y-%m-%d'), ProdName ) T_SUM GROUP BY StockDate, OrderName
